description: Governance enforcement harness — defines all rules, artifacts, checks, and watchdog handshake for sprint execution

rules: Implementing Role must differ from Reviewing Role
Timestamp must be within 30 minutes of commit
File must be more than 5 lines (catch boilerplate)

modes.watch: Real-time monitoring via inotifywait, writes evidence/watchdog-alerts.log
modes.verify-ack: Checks watchdog-ack.txt matches latest report (called by pre-commit hook)

checks: C1: sprints.json integrity (max 1 in_progress, all committed have hash, no duplicates, batch commit detection)
C2: Evidence artifact completeness (all required files present, orphan detection)
C3: Cross-sign validity (approved verdict, different roles, min 5 lines)
C4: Enforcer checklist validity (APPROVED, not BLOCKED)
C5: Uncommitted evidence accumulation (max 1 untracked evidence dir)
C6: Destructive change detection (deletions > insertions in pages, data array removal, endpoint removal)
C8: Hook integrity (md5 match between source and installed)
C9: Chain of custody (all commit hashes exist, chronological order, batch detection)
C10: Timestamp anomaly detection (identical mtimes, future timestamps)
C11: Plan file alignment (status matches sprint progress)
C12: Protected path monitoring (governance files, scripts, hook — watch mode only)

flow: Watchdog runs scan → writes watchdog-report.txt with Report-ID
If violations exist → dev agent writes watchdog-ack.txt
Ack must contain: Report-ID (exact match), Acknowledged-By, Sprint, Timestamp
Ack must address every violation check ID (C1, C2, etc.)
Pre-commit hook Gate 1.6 calls verify-ack → blocks if ack invalid

ack_format.violation_responses: One line per violation check ID with ACKNOWLEDGED and explanation

gates: Gate 1: COMMIT_ROLE and COMMIT_SPRINT env vars required
Gate 1.5: Previous sprint must be committed (chain of custody)
Gate 1.6: Watchdog acknowledgment (verify-ack must pass if report has violations)
Gate 2: Evidence directory must exist and be non-empty
Gate 3: Enforcer checklist must exist and be APPROVED + fresh
Gate 4: Cross-sign must exist, APPROVED, different roles, fresh
Gate 5: Staged files within role scope
Gate 6: EF checks (TypeScript, UI guards, data guards, locked values)

checks: Session state mtime < 4 hours (blocks all tools if stale)
Bypass: allows writes to session-state.md when stale (prevents deadlock)

rules: in_progress status requires evidence directory to exist
planned status must not have evidence artifacts
only one sprint may be in_progress at a time
commitHash field name must be consistent (not 'commit')

l2_and_above.pre08_gate: User stories must be defined before any L2+ testing sprint
l2_and_above.dual_agent: Two independent agents execute the same tests, orchestrator compares

harness_check_skill.checks: 10 deterministic checks matching watchdog C1-C11 + hook integrity
